restoration_note: The teaching catalogues nine cosmic thrones (described as eight in the heading) — fixed registers of divine recognition outside the formed cosmos — followed by nine more within it (three in each of two ships, plus three at fixed firmaments). Most gaps are letter-level completions of standard formulae (ordinal sequence, ⲉⲧⲥⲙⲁⲁⲛⲧ formula, ⲉⲩϣⲟⲟⲡ, ⲍⲓⲧⲉϥϩⲏ, ⲇⲉⲥⲙⲟⲫⲩⲗⲁⲕⲏ) constrained by surviving traces and the ordinal/parallel structure. Substantive content gaps are constrained by the throne-list (Living Spirit's epithet, the First Man being raised from the contest, the worlds of light established, fettering of Enmity's powers, the Light Mind as ninth throne to whom churches gather and the Light entire is gathered). The closing summary (sections 1801-1805) is too fragmentary to restore beyond the editor's anchored letters; gaps 28, 43-47 left unrestorable.
